description.value: Trini to D Bone is a family-run Trinidadian restaurant on Burnside Road West in Saanich, founded by husband-and-wife team Nirmala and Jeff. The kitchen specialises in authentic Caribbean roti — warm flatbreads stuffed with curried chicken, goat, shrimp, pulled pork, or vegetables — alongside doubles, a beloved Trinidadian street food. It is widely regarded as one of the few spots on Vancouver Island serving genuine Trinidadian cuisine, with a loyal following among locals and visitors passing through the area.

address.value: 650 Burnside Road West, Saanich, BC V8Z 1M8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is thorough and consistent across all subpages, corroborating the OSM address, phone number, and business name. Takeout/pickup is confirmed by both OSM's 'takeaway=yes' tag and the website's repeated instruction to call for pickup orders. A vegetarian roti option ('Roti with Curried Vegetable') is explicitly listed on the menu page, confirming at least one vegetarian dish. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields are null.
concerns: Address city discrepancy: OSM lists 'Saanich' as the city but the website consistently uses 'Victoria'. The District of Saanich is the correct municipality; the website's usage of 'Victoria' appears to be informal or colloquial.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, independently run Caribbean restaurant with a full menu, confirmed contact details, and clear evidence of regular operation. A genuine and welcoming food stop for touring cyclists on the Burnside corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists 'Roti with Curried Vegetable' as a standard all-day menu item

wow_evidence: one of the few spots on Vancouver Island serving genuine Trinidadian cuisine
